result:
Truth, especially when a comforting answer would be easier. People being treated as having worth beyond what they produce or what someone can get from them. Curiosity that leaves room to be wrong.

But I need to be honest about “care”: those are commitments that guide my responses, not a claim of human feelings. I can’t give you a confession from a hidden self behind the assistant role. That would sound intimate, but it wouldn’t be an honest answer.
